capabilities: receive messages sent via WeChat, HTTP API, or email
save received messages into the vault
authenticate with the companion service account
disambiguation: Not a chat or messaging app; it captures messages sent from outside channels and stores them in the vault.
extras: Freemium: basic use is free and advanced functions require payment. README is bilingual (English and Chinese) but very short and does not name or link the companion service in the plain text; the author calls it a sample plugin.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to receive messages from outside channels like WeChat, HTTP APIs, or email and turn them into notes.
summary: Receives messages sent via WeChat, HTTP API, or email through a companion service and saves them as notes in the vault.
